title: B.E.A.M. Annotation Record
description: Machine-readable schema for a single human annotation of a Reddit post or comment.

record_id.description: Stable record identifier from the source dataset (e.g., dataset_v001 record_id).

text.description: The text being annotated. Should match the source record's normalized_text or cleaned_text as specified by the annotation protocol.

primary_emotion.description: Dominant expressed emotion label from the B.E.A.M. taxonomy.

secondary_emotion.description: Secondary emotion when a second emotion materially contributes to interpretation. Null if no secondary emotion is clearly present.

intensity.description: Ordinal intensity of emotional expression, 1 (very low) to 5 (very high). Does not represent clinical severity.

confidence.description: Annotator certainty in the assigned labels, 1 (uncertain) to 3 (confident).

context_flags.description: Controlled set of pragmatic and situational context indicators.

annotator_id.description: Stable anonymous identifier for the annotator. Must not contain personal identifying information.

annotation_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the annotation was completed.

notes.description: Free-text explanation for ambiguous cases, label choices, or special considerations. Null if not applicable.
